items.label: Rule 1
items.text: Never compile without nuking the whole _build/prod tree.

items.label: Rule 2
items.text: A note with no lead run-in still renders its label chip and body.
And a note with no label leads straight into its bold run-in.

items.title: Info card
items.text: An informational card carries the neutral-info tone border.

items.title: OK card
items.text: A success card is tinted with the ok/success tone.

items.title: Warn card
items.text: A warning card draws attention with the warn tone border.

items.title: Danger card
items.text: A danger card signals a destructive or failing state.
